name: Adaptive Sampling for Interaction
aliases: Adaptive Sampling for Interactive Volume Rendering
definition: A strategy to lower sampling rates during user interaction to maintain performance, then re-render at higher rates after actions are completed.
summary: Adaptive Sampling for Interaction dynamically lowers rendering quality during user activity to maintain responsiveness, then restores high fidelity after interaction ceases, differing from static or error-based methods by prioritizing temporal responsiveness over local data complexity.
